headword: {居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}

definitions.explanation: The space within a home where people live and spend their daily time. Commonly used when discussing home design, floor plans, and comfort.

examples.japanese: {快適|かいてき}な{居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}。
{限|かぎ}られた{居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}を{有効|ゆうこう}に{使|つか}う。
examples.english: To make effective use of a limited living space.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}が{増|ふ}えたので、{広|ひろ}い{居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}のある{家|いえ}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}すことにした。
examples.english: Because our family grew, we decided to move to a house with more living space.

notes:
Composed of {居住|きょじゅう} (residence, dwelling) and {空間|くうかん} (space). A somewhat formal and technical term used in architecture, interior design, and real estate contexts. In everyday casual speech, people more often talk about the {部屋|へや} (rooms), {間取|まど}り (floor plan), or simply the house's {広|ひろ}さ (size). {居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん} emphasizes the livable, usable area rather than raw square footage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {快適|かいてき}な{居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}: a comfortable living space
- {広|ひろ}い{居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}: a spacious living area
- {居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}を{確保|かくほ}する: to secure living space
- {居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}を{有効活用|ゆうこうかつよう}する: to make effective use of living space

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {住空間|じゅうくうかん}: short form, same meaning
- リビング: living room — specifically the common area
- {間取|まど}り: floor plan, layout of a home
- {住|す}まい: dwelling, residence — more abstract/emotional word for "where one lives"

cross_references.label: floor plan, layout of a home
